blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Vice President Sara Duterte skipped her office’s budget deliberations at the House of Representatives on Tuesday, remaining absent from the chamber’s floor as lawmakers were set to debate her spending plan amid her impeachment trial in the Senate. Lemuel Ortonio, an assistant secretary at the Office of the Vice President (OVP), was the highest-ranking official attending the office’s spending talks at the House plenary. It is unclear if Duterte will show up later. The OVP requested P785.20 million in funding for 2027, 11.69 percent lower than its P889.23 million budget for this year.
